# TestScript for 04-positional-args
# Asserts required positionals, optional positionals, trailing positional slices, and enum constraints

# 1. Missing mandatory <channel> argument
exit-status 2 positional-args
stderr 'missing required positional argument <channel>'

# 2. Invalid enum value for positional argument <channel>
exit-status 2 positional-args discord
stderr 'invalid value "discord" \(must be one of: slack, email, sms, webhook\) for argument <channel>'

# 3. Single positional argument (optional message defaults to fallback)
exec positional-args slack
stdout '<channel>\s+string\s+slack\s+● cli'
stdout '\[message\]\s+string\s+—\s+○ unset'
stdout 'Broadcast: channel=slack message="Ping health check" urgent=false extra_recipients=0'

# 4. Two positional arguments
exec positional-args slack 'Deployment complete'
stdout '<channel>\s+string\s+slack\s+● cli'
stdout '\[message\]\s+string\s+Deployment complete\s+● cli'
stdout 'Broadcast: channel=slack message="Deployment complete" urgent=false extra_recipients=0'

# 5. Trailing positional slice with flags
exec positional-args -u email 'Database failover' devops oncall lead
stdout '-u, --urgent\s+bool\s+true\s+● cli --urgent'
stdout '<channel>\s+string\s+email\s+● cli'
stdout '\[message\]\s+string\s+Database failover\s+● cli'
stdout '\[recipients\.\.\.\]\s+\[\]string\s+\[devops, oncall, lead\]\s+● cli'
stdout 'Broadcast: channel=email message="Database failover" urgent=true extra_recipients=3'

# 6. Help screen shows positional argument names and enum
exec positional-args --help
stdout 'Usage:'
stdout 'positional-args \[flags\] <channel> \[message\] \[recipients\.\.\.\]'
stdout '<channel>\s+Target channel \[enum: slack, email, sms, webhook\]'
stdout '\[message\]\s+Broadcast message payload'
stdout '\[recipients\.\.\.\]\s+Additional recipient tags or handles'
